description: codex-cli 0.162.1 under `-s read-only`: the worker MCP server's tool call stops at codex's own 'Allow the <server> MCP server to run tool "<tool>"?' prompt (4 options). Captured live 2026-10-29 (mission fea90234); previously the session stayed `generating` for 15+ minutes with no approval modal.

anchors.name: MCP tool approval prompt

parseApproval.message: Allow the adhdev-worker MCP server to run tool "ping_tool"?
buttons: Allow                   Run the tool and continue
Allow for this session  Run the tool and remember this choice for this session
Always allow            Run the tool and remember this choice for future tool calls
Cancel                  Cancel this tool call enter to submit | esc to cancel

anchors.notes: Button labels carry codex's description column (and the footer on the last one, continuationLines) verbatim; answers are index-keyed, so the labels are cosmetic.
